verdict.rationale: Quo's own docs show voicemails are transcribed, and its official MCP connectors let a user see those transcripts directly from an AI chat without dialing in. However, this is on-demand retrieval inside Claude or ChatGPT, not automatic delivery: no evidence shows transcripts being pushed to email or a team chat app. The transcript webhooks are only a developer building block and earn no credit. Missing for 10: automatic push delivery of voicemail transcripts to email, native delivery to chat apps such as Slack or Teams, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, voicemails are transcribed and delivered to email or chat so I can read them without dialing in

citations.quote: Get info about your missed calls to your Quo numbers, and see their voicemail transcripts directly from your chat.
Retrieve call history and voicemail transcripts from your Quo number.
